mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) is causally linked to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reduces the cost of capital for firms and increases the present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for the FEDFUNDS-SPX 20d return relationship.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which precedes corporate earnings deterioration and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increasing in the past month) signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rising in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST falling below the 3-month moving average) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 3-month MA (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 for HOUST signal.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production level (INDPRO) is a leading indicator of economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for the INDPRO-SPX 60d return relationship.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales growth (RSAFS growth rate below 0.5% in the past month) signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS growth < 0.5% in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% in the past month) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE increasing by more than 0.1 percentage points) signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation environment, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS increasing by more than 0.25 percentage points in the past month) signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high inflation environments (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS signal < 0.03.
